title: Traditional Arno River Barchetto Cruise with Tuscan Aperitivo
description: The quintessential Florentine river experience — glide aboard an authentic wooden barchetto pushed by a traditional renaiolo boatman, sipping chilled Prosecco or Chianti wine as you pass directly beneath Ponte Vecchio.
includes: Glass of Prosecco or Tuscan wine & snacks
Live commentary on Florence Renaissance history
imageAlt: Traditional wooden barchetto boat cruising on the Arno River in Florence past Ponte Vecchio
bestFor: First-time visitors and travelers wanting authentic Florentine river heritage

title: Romantic Arno River Sunset Cruise with Drinks & Live Commentary
description: Experience golden hour magic in Florence from the water. Watch the sun dip behind Ponte Santa Trinita while the arches of Ponte Vecchio and the Uffizi Gallery glow in warm amber light.
imageAlt: Couple enjoying wine on a sunset boat cruise on the Arno River in Florence
bestFor: Couples, photographers, and romantic evening celebrations

title: Florence Arno River Sightseeing Cruise with Audio Guide
description: An eco-friendly electric boat cruise along the Arno riverbank. Perfect for families and sightseeing enthusiasts seeking a relaxed overview of Palazzo Vecchio, the Vasari Corridor, and the historic Oltrarno.
imageAlt: Florence Arno River electric sightseeing boat cruising along the illuminated riverbank
bestFor: Budget-conscious travelers, families, and quick highlights

title: Private Traditional Barchetto Boat Tour on the Arno River
description: An exclusive private charter of a handcrafted Florentine barchetto just for your group. Includes premium Chianti Classico wine, artisan Tuscan cheeses, and personalized storytelling by your master boatman.
includes: Bottle of premium Chianti Classico & artisanal snacks
imageAlt: Private luxury barchetto boat charter on the Arno River near Ponte Vecchio in Florence
bestFor: Honeymoons, proposals, anniversaries, and VIP small groups

title: Uffizi Gallery Priority Entry + Arno River Boat Cruise Combo
description: Combine Florence's greatest art museum with its most serene perspective. Explore Botticelli and Da Vinci inside the Uffizi with priority access, followed by a scenic Arno River boat tour.
includes: Audio guide app for Florence walking route
imageAlt: Ponte Vecchio bridge and the Uffizi Gallery riverfront viewed from an Arno river cruise
bestFor: Culture lovers looking to combine Renaissance art and river sightseeing

title: Accademia Gallery (David) Skip-the-Line + Arno River Cruise
description: Marvel at Michelangelo's David inside the Accademia Gallery without waiting in long queues, then unwind aboard an open-air river cruise floating under the historic bridges of Florence.
imageAlt: Historic bridge over the Arno River in Firenze, Florence
bestFor: Visitors seeking Florence must-do highlights in one convenient package
